description: Create a transfer from an active quote. The quote must not be expired. With fundingSource fund_transfer (the default) this only creates the transfer and returns deposit instructions; no money moves until someone deposits the funds. With prefund_balance it debits your organisation's balance and starts the payout immediately, so this moves real money: get explicit human approval first. For payouts in AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD you must also supply recipientType, the full beneficiary address, and dateOfBirth when the recipient is an individual. To pay one of the organisation's saved beneficiaries, set destinationType to beneficiary and pass its beneficiaryId instead of bank details.

accountHolderName.description: Account holder's full name, or the company name when recipientType is business

accountNumber.description: Bank account number, if not using IBAN

accountType.description: Account type. Required for CAD and USD bank payouts

addressCountry.description: Beneficiary country, ISO 2-letter. The complete address is required for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

beneficiaryId.description: Saved beneficiary id when destinationType is beneficiary. It supplies the recipient and bank details, so the bank fields are ignored; archived beneficiaries are refused

customerId.description: The customer ID for this transfer

dateOfBirth.description: Beneficiary date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when recipientType is individual for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

destinationAddress.description: Wallet address when destinationType is crypto

destinationCurrency.description: Stablecoin to deliver when destinationType is crypto (e.g. 'USDT')

destinationNetwork.description: Blockchain network when destinationType is crypto (e.g. 'polygon')

destinationType.description: Payout target: a bank account (off-ramp), a wallet address, or a saved beneficiary

fundingSource.description: fund_transfer (default) creates the transfer and returns deposit instructions; nothing moves until a person deposits the funds. prefund_balance debits your organisation's balance and starts the payout immediately, so it needs explicit human approval. Check get_balance first: transfers_enabled must be true and the quote's source asset must be held on its network

payIdType.description: PayID alias type. Required when payId is given

purposeCode.description: Purpose of the transfer (e.g. 'SALARY'). Required on some corridors

recipientType.description: Beneficiary type. Required for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

name: create_transfer
title: Create transfer (moves money)
